body: Rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-23, revised 04:20Z), from w-33f4 gate test-344041c2. Once a coder hands its worktree to Merger and Merger gates it in place (as with wt-eval-token-11465 for BarA1's w-33f4), the coder must not read or edit files there with its agent tools. Its follow-ups go in a separate worktree, and it inspects reviewed content through git show or the object store. In this case the host saw <file>.tmp.91536.<hex> from BarA1's claude.exe although BarA1's transcript shows no Edit or Write since 01:30Z. The suspected cause is a Claude Code harness background write in a worktree the session once edited (filed as w-47e49c222faf). Diagnosis: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process for the pid gives the --resume id, which maps to a session through /api/state. Merger checks the gate tree against the reviewed tree after the run and relaunches only from restored, reviewed content.
